source_policy: Objectives and baseline rewards are populated only where independently supported; unresolved drop attribution remains explicit.

records.name: Off-The-Charts Energy
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Fu and the other enemies after meeting the first two objectives.
rewards: Right, then... Let's begin the experiment!

records.name: The Final Battle Before the Final Battle?!
objectives: Defeat all enemies except for Beerus
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Beerus and the remaining enemies after the preceding conditions.
rewards: For beauty! For elegance! For love!
This Super Saiyan 2 is crazy strong!

records.name: Planetary Possession
objectives: Clear with Super Baby 2's health over 50%
Defeat Omega, Eis, and Nuova Shenron
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Omega, Eis, and Nuova Shenron after preserving Super Baby 2 above 50% health.

records.name: Downfall of the Ultimate Saiyan
objectives: Defeat Super Baby 2 after he heals at least 3 times
Defeat Great Ape Baby and the others
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Great Ape Baby and the remaining enemies after Super Baby 2 has healed at least three times.
rewards: Don't think I'm the same as before!

records.name: Proof's in the Potara
objectives: Defeat Goku (Ultra Instinct), Beerus, and Champa
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Goku (Ultra Instinct), Beerus, and Champa after preserving Kefla above 50% health.

records.name: Catch Kefla If You Can!
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Kefla and the remaining enemies after reaching the lookout within the time condition.
rewards: Alright! Let's go wreck some faces!

records.name: Multiverse Match of the Century
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Kefla and the remaining enemies after the time condition.

records.name: Legendary Super Saiyan Smackdown
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Broly (Full Power Super Saiyan) after the first two conditions.
rewards: I've waited an unbelievably long time for this...

records.name: Frieza Force on the Hunt
objectives: Clear with any NPC's health over 50%
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Gotenks and SSGSS Gogeta after preserving an NPC above 50% health.
rewards: Heh heh! Now THIS is real power!
Hey, you think you could fight a little quieter?!
Don't think I'm gonna show you any gratitude!

records.name: Legendary Starving Saiyan Broly
objectives: Clear with Broly (Full Power Super Saiyan)'s health over 50%
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Broly (Full Power Super Saiyan) after preserving the allied Broly above 50% health.
rewards: Hey, you! You ready for me?!
Hmph. I'm off to take a nap.

records.name: Fight of the Fusions! Vegito vs Gogeta
objectives: Clear in under 10 and a half minutes
Defeat SSGSS Gogeta and SSGSS Vegito
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat SSGSS Gogeta and SSGSS Vegito after the time condition.
rewards: You'd better survive, you got that?!
Shall we pick up where we left off?

records.name: The Ultimate Legendary Super Saiyan
objectives: Defeat Broly (Full Power Super Saiyan) and others
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Broly (Full Power Super Saiyan) and the remaining enemies while preserving the allied Broly above 50% health.
rewards: This is no time to mess around...
I can't have you dying on me!

records.name: Ribrianne's Beauty Lesson
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Ribrianne and the remaining enemies after the time condition.
rewards: I got my claws in you, and fangs too!

records.name: Universe 7's Next God of Destruction
objectives: Clear in under 6 and a half minutes
Defeat Goku (Ultra Instinct) and the others
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Goku (Ultra Instinct) and the remaining enemies after the time condition.
rewards: Power! A lotta power! It's great!

records.name: Ribrianne, Defender of Love and Justice
objectives: Defeat Mira (Final Form) and the others
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Mira (Final Form) and the remaining enemies while preserving Ribrianne above 50% health.

records.name: Breaking Down the Barrier
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Goku (Ultra Instinct) after the time condition.
rewards: Justice is nothing to me now.

records.name: Tournament of Power Round 2
objectives: Clear with at least 8 and a half minutes left
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Jiren and the remaining enemies after preserving the time condition.
rewards: That heat... I'll have to match it.

records.name: The Battle of Earth
objectives: Defeat Omega Shenron and the others
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Omega Shenron and the remaining enemies while Goku (GT) survives.
rewards: I'm not gonna die until I defeat you!
I just flew around the whole world!

records.name: War and Pieces
objectives: Defeat Frieza (Final Form) and the others
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Frieza (Final Form) and the remaining enemies after the time condition.

records.name: Spirit Bomb Away!
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Android 21 and the remaining enemies after surviving four minutes and preserving Goku above 70% health.
rewards: This thing carries hopes of everyone on Earth!
Now then, time for another delightful hunt!

records.name: Uub's Ultimate Challenge
objectives: Defeat Golden Frieza and the others
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Golden Frieza and the remaining enemies while preserving Majuub above 50% health.
rewards: D-Don't talk bad about my family!

records.name: Timespace Tussle
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Fu and the remaining enemies while preserving your health above 60%.
rewards: I don't want them to get hurt!
